description:
The seed copies website/, results-explorer/, landing/, docs/blog/, _blog/ and _project/design/site-inventory/ from core once. Core keeps changing those paths until site-split-50 deletes them; five such PRs merged in one day (#2726, #2753, #2763, #2768, #2614). Without a rule, those changes would be lost.

Owner decision D-Q: replay, no freeze.

1. Use the seed commit recorded in site-split-20 as the starting point.
2. Before site-split-25, before site-split-40, and as a precondition of site-split-50, list `git log <last replayed>..origin/develop -- <seeded paths>`.
3. Port each listed commit to the site repo in a site PR, applying the seed renames (results-explorer/ to explorer/, docs/blog/ to blog/, _blog/ to drafts/, _project/design/site-inventory/ to inventory/). Name the core commit in the PR body.
4. Record the last replayed core commit in this item's context after each pass.

Finish this item when site-split-50's PR is ready and the list is empty.
